patches_modified.name: All-In-One
patches_modified.description: Enables video playback and downloads, removes ads and upsell prompts, bypasses the region block, and unlocks the hidden Laboratory menu. Requires Android 10 or later.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks premium servers and removes ads, upgrade banners, the launch paywall and the Android TV sign-in screen.

patches_added.name: Hide layout components
patches_added.description: Adds settings to hide the Help center, Spread the word and About sections.

patches_added.name: Fix videos that won't send
patches_added.description: Messenger stops two kinds of video with "Unable to send". One is a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. The other is a Samsung screen recording whose recorder tag Messenger's media check rejects. Whether you share one into Messenger from another app or pick it in a chat, the sound is converted to regular AAC, or the tag is dropped, so it sends. The picture isn't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hold stories at the end
patches_added.description: Keeps a story on screen when it ends instead of moving on to the next one, so you go on with a tap or a swipe. Photos and videos both wait, and the last story stays open until you close it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Mark as read button
patches_added.description: Puts Messenger's Mark as read icon in a chat's top bar while Hide read receipts is on. Opening the chat still sends nothing, and a tap on the icon sends Seen and marks the chat read. It takes the place of the chat details button, since tapping the chat's name opens the same page, so the call buttons stay put. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_removed.name: Fix shared videos with xHE-AAC sound
patches_removed.description: Messenger can't send a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. Whether you share one into Messenger from another app or pick it in a chat, its sound is converted to regular AAC first, so it sends. The picture isn't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over or keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

Warnings stay red, and so can icons with the red drawn in. It's built in while patching, so only patching again without it undoes it.

patches_added.name: Anonymous chat
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that reads chat as an anonymous guest, the way Twitch does when signed out, while the rest of the app stays signed in, so you aren't listed among a channel's chatters. Sending chat messages is disabled while it's on. Off by default; applies after a restart.

patches_added.name: Auto-claim channel points
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that claims the channel points bonus for your account as soon as its chest appears in a channel's chat, with the same request as tapping the chest. Each bonus is claimed once. Off by default; needs a signed-in account.

patches_added.name: Avoid stitched ads
patches_added.description: While Twitch's server stitches an ad break into a live stream, plays the stream instead from a picture-by-picture session, the kind Twitch itself shows during breaks, which gets no ads: at 360p at most, with sound, then back to the stream's own session and quality when the break is over. The player doesn't reload. The playback token for that session is requested without your account. When none can be had, the break plays, and Mute stitched ads still mutes and covers it. Native and React Native players; streams started while it's off are left alone.

patches_added.name: Background audio
patches_added.description: Keeps streams and videos playing as audio when you leave the app, using Twitch's own "Continue Playing Audio in the Background" with its audio-only stream and media notification. Changes only the default, Never in Twitch: a choice made in Twitch's settings still wins.

patches_added.name: Block display ads
patches_added.description: Blocks the ad requests that Block client ads doesn't cover: stream display ads (squeezeback and lower third), audio ads, multi-format ad pods, the Following headliner, feed display and video ads and brand surveys, in both the native and React Native parts of the app. Each request gets the failure or no-ad answer Twitch already handles. Sponsorship and paid-promotion labels are kept. Ads stitched into the stream by the server still play.

patches_added.name: Chat appearance
patches_added.description: Adds chat look settings: text size, alternating row backgrounds, plain /me messages, and the width and background opacity of the landscape chat panel. Each keeps Twitch's look until changed in Lurk settings. Native live chat, chat history and VOD chat replay; not React Native chat.

patches_added.name: Chat keywords
patches_added.description: Highlights chat messages that mention you or contain your highlight words with a tinted background, optionally with a vibration, and hides messages with blocked words or from blocked users. Mentions are on by default; the word and user lists start empty and are set in Lurk settings. Native live chat, chat history and VOD chat replay; not React Native chat.

patches_added.name: Chat overlay
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that scrolls live chat messages right to left across the top of the video in landscape (danmaku), as plain white text with the sender's name. Off until turned on in Lurk settings, with choices for speed and number of lines. Native live channels only: not React Native chat, VODs or chat replay. The overlay never takes touches.

patches_added.name: Chat timestamps
patches_added.description: Shows the time each live chat message was sent in front of it, the way Twitch already shows it on chat history, in 24-hour or 12-hour format. Whispers are unchanged.

patches_added.name: Default startup tab
patches_added.description: Adds a choice of the screen Twitch opens on instead of Home: Browse, Following or Activity. Links and notifications still open what they point to.

patches_added.name: Fix notifications
patches_added.description: Lets the patched app register for push notifications. Firebase only accepts Twitch's original package name and signing certificate, and refuses the re-signed app, so its registration requests send the original ones.

patches_added.name: Fix stuck start screen
patches_added.description: Opens Twitch when its start screen is still waiting after 5 seconds. Twitch waits for Branch's link lookup before it routes, and when that never answers, it stays on a blank start screen until it's closed, unpatched Twitch included.

patches_added.name: Force ExoPlayer
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that plays live channels and videos with the ExoPlayer backend Twitch still ships instead of Amazon IVS. Off until turned on in Lurk settings. Clips, encrypted streams and React Native players stay on IVS. Lurk patches that hook IVS, such as Normal latency, Mute stitched ads and Show video stats, don't act on ExoPlayer.

patches_added.name: Hide Home sections
patches_added.description: Hides Stories on Home and, each with its own switch, the Continue watching, offline channels and recommended channels sections of Following.

patches_added.name: Hide chat highlights
patches_added.description: Hides the Hype Train, Bits and gift leaderboards, other viewers' sub and gift messages and gift banners, pinned cheers and watch-streak pop-ups, each with its own switch. Celebrations can be hidden too. Other chat messages are unchanged.

patches_added.name: Hide mature content warning
patches_added.description: Skips the content warning on streams, videos and clips with mature content labels, as if you had chosen Start Watching. Age, region, guardian and account restrictions still apply. Off by default.

patches_added.name: Hide player buttons
patches_added.description: Hides the player's Clip, Cast and Share buttons, each with its own switch. Cast stays visible by default. Other ways to clip and share, such as the channel page, are unchanged.

patches_added.name: Mute stitched ads
patches_added.description: While an ad break that Twitch's server stitched into a stream plays, mutes the player and covers the video with black, then restores both when the stream returns. Works in the native and React Native players. The ad still plays and the break isn't shorter.

patches_added.name: Navigation bar position
patches_added.description: Adds a choice that moves Twitch's bottom navigation bar to the top of the screen and/or hides its labels, leaving only the icons. Twitch's own layout stays until another choice is made in Lurk settings.

patches_added.name: Normal latency
patches_added.description: Adds a setting that turns off the player's low-latency mode for live streams: a few seconds more delay to the broadcaster, for fewer rebuffers on a weak connection. Off until turned on in Lurk settings.

patches_added.name: Player gestures
patches_added.description: Sets the skip interval of the video (VOD) rewind and forward buttons and the media notification, and adds brightness (left) and volume (right) swipes on the video in landscape. Twitch's -10/+30 seconds stay until you choose another interval in Lurk settings; swipes start off.

patches_added.name: Playlist proxy
patches_added.description: Sends live stream playlist requests to a proxy server you set in this patch's options, for example one that returns playlists without stitched ads. The proxy receives each request in full, including your signed playback token, which identifies your account: only use a proxy you trust. An http:// proxy gets an exception from Twitch's HTTPS-only rule for its host alone, and the token then travels unencrypted. Does nothing while the proxy URL is empty. Videos and clips are not proxied.

patches_added.name: Refresh stream
patches_added.description: Long-press the player's settings gear, or the middle of the video, to reload a stuck stream through Twitch's own Retry: a new access token and playlist for live streams, the same position for videos. Covers Twitch's native players.

patches_added.name: Show deleted messages
patches_added.description: Keeps the text of chat messages that moderators delete, or remove with a timeout or ban, struck through and dimmed instead of Twitch's "message deleted" placeholder. A second switch keeps the messages when a moderator clears the whole chat.

patches_added.name: Show video stats
patches_added.description: Adds the video stats button Twitch shows only to its staff to the native player: latency to the broadcaster, bitrate, buffer, dropped frames, codecs and server. Everything shown is local to the player.

patches_added.name: Sleep timer
patches_added.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, through Twitch's own pause for native, portal and React Native players, and says so in a short notice. Choose the time in Lurk settings; it is off until then.

patches_added.name: Tablet layout
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that makes Twitch treat the phone as a tablet: Home and the player rotate, the player shows chat beside the video in landscape, and a navigation rail on the left replaces the bottom bar in landscape (and in portrait too with a second switch). Off until turned on in Lurk settings; applies after a restart.

patches_added.name: Third-party badges
patches_added.description: Adds switches that show FrankerFaceZ and Chatterino badges and pronouns.alejo.io pronouns next to chatters' names in native chat. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings. The badge switches download that service's public list of all badge holders (api.frankerfacez.com, api.chatterino.com) about once an hour and check it on the phone. The pronouns switch sends the username of each chatter whose message you see to pronouns.alejo.io. 7TV badges are not included.

patches_added.name: Third-party emotes
patches_added.description: Adds switches that show 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes in chat, Twitch's chat history and VOD chat replay. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings; when on, it sends the ID of the channel you watch to that service (7tv.io, api.betterttv.net, api.frankerfacez.com) for its emote lists and loads the emote images from its CDN. Not in the emote picker or autocomplete.

patches_added.name: Use native player
patches_added.description: Always opens live channels in Twitch's native player, never the React Native "Ultralight" player a server experiment can switch some users to. Most Lurk playback, chat and ad patches hook the native player.

patches_added.name: VOD chapters
patches_added.description: Adds a Chapters button to the native video (VOD) player that lists the stream's game and category changes and jumps to one through Twitch's own seek. The list comes from Twitch's public data, fetched with the app's client ID. On by default.

patches_added.name: Watch without signing in
patches_added.description: Opens Twitch without an account instead of stopping at the Log In / Sign Up screen, using Twitch's own signed-out mode. Streams, videos and chat can be watched; following, chatting and other account actions still ask you to sign in. Signed-in use is unchanged.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Twitch's native and React Native Spade event uploads, denies local analytics SDK consent, enables Branch's limited tracking mode, blocks Crashlytics uploads, Nielsen audience pings and Sprig surveys, and prevents Sentry initialization. Watch progress, viewing statistics and rewards may stop updating. Restart Twitch after changing this setting. Playback requests still run.

Sponsorship and paid-promotion labels are kept. Ads stitched into the stream by the server still play.

patches_added.name: Chat appearance
patches_added.description: Adds chat look settings: text size, alternating row backgrounds, plain /me messages, and the width and background opacity of the landscape chat panel. Each keeps Twitch's look until changed in Lurk settings. Native live chat, chat history and VOD chat replay; not React Native chat.

patches_added.name: Chat keywords
patches_added.description: Highlights chat messages that mention you or contain your highlight words with a tinted background, optionally with a vibration, and hides messages with blocked words or from blocked users. Mentions are on by default; the word and user lists start empty and are set in Lurk settings. Native live chat, chat history and VOD chat replay; not React Native chat.

patches_added.name: Chat overlay
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that scrolls live chat messages right to left across the top of the video in landscape (danmaku), as plain white text with the sender's name. Off until turned on in Lurk settings, with choices for speed and number of lines. Native live channels only: not React Native chat, VODs or chat replay. The overlay never takes touches.

patches_added.name: Chat timestamps
patches_added.description: Shows the time each live chat message was sent in front of it, the way Twitch already shows it on chat history, in 24-hour or 12-hour format. Whispers are unchanged.

patches_added.name: Default startup tab
patches_added.description: Adds a choice of the screen Twitch opens on instead of Home: Browse, Following or Activity. Links and notifications still open what they point to.

patches_added.name: Fix notifications
patches_added.description: Lets the patched app register for push notifications. Firebase only accepts Twitch's original package name and signing certificate, and refuses the re-signed app, so its registration requests send the original ones.

patches_added.name: Fix stuck start screen
patches_added.description: Opens Twitch when its start screen is still waiting after 5 seconds. Twitch waits for Branch's link lookup before it routes, and when that never answers, it stays on a blank start screen until it's closed, unpatched Twitch included.

patches_added.name: Force ExoPlayer
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that plays live channels and videos with the ExoPlayer backend Twitch still ships instead of Amazon IVS. Off until turned on in Lurk settings. Clips, encrypted streams and React Native players stay on IVS. Lurk patches that hook IVS, such as Normal latency, Mute stitched ads and Show video stats, don't act on ExoPlayer.

patches_added.name: Hide Home sections
patches_added.description: Hides Stories on Home and, each with its own switch, the Continue watching, offline channels and recommended channels sections of Following.

patches_added.name: Hide chat highlights
patches_added.description: Hides the Hype Train, Bits and gift leaderboards, other viewers' sub and gift messages and gift banners, pinned cheers and watch-streak pop-ups, each with its own switch. Celebrations can be hidden too. Other chat messages are unchanged.

patches_added.name: Hide mature content warning
patches_added.description: Skips the content warning on streams, videos and clips with mature content labels, as if you had chosen Start Watching. Age, region, guardian and account restrictions still apply. Off by default.

patches_added.name: Hide player buttons
patches_added.description: Hides the player's Clip, Cast and Share buttons, each with its own switch. Cast stays visible by default. Other ways to clip and share, such as the channel page, are unchanged.

patches_added.name: Mute stitched ads
patches_added.description: While an ad break that Twitch's server stitched into a stream plays, mutes the player and covers the video with black, then restores both when the stream returns. Works in the native and React Native players. The ad still plays and the break isn't shorter.

patches_added.name: Navigation bar position
patches_added.description: Adds a choice that moves Twitch's bottom navigation bar to the top of the screen and/or hides its labels, leaving only the icons. Twitch's own layout stays until another choice is made in Lurk settings.

patches_added.name: Normal latency
patches_added.description: Adds a setting that turns off the player's low-latency mode for live streams: a few seconds more delay to the broadcaster, for fewer rebuffers on a weak connection. Off until turned on in Lurk settings.

patches_added.name: Player gestures
patches_added.description: Sets the skip interval of the video (VOD) rewind and forward buttons and the media notification, and adds brightness (left) and volume (right) swipes on the video in landscape. Twitch's -10/+30 seconds stay until you choose another interval in Lurk settings; swipes start off.

patches_added.name: Playlist proxy
patches_added.description: Sends live stream playlist requests to a proxy server you set in this patch's options, for example one that returns playlists without stitched ads. The proxy receives each request in full, including your signed playback token, which identifies your account: only use a proxy you trust. An http:// proxy gets an exception from Twitch's HTTPS-only rule for its host alone, and the token then travels unencrypted. Does nothing while the proxy URL is empty. Videos and clips are not proxied.

patches_added.name: Refresh stream
patches_added.description: Long-press the player's settings gear, or the middle of the video, to reload a stuck stream through Twitch's own Retry: a new access token and playlist for live streams, the same position for videos. Covers Twitch's native players.

patches_added.name: Show deleted messages
patches_added.description: Keeps the text of chat messages that moderators delete, or remove with a timeout or ban, struck through and dimmed instead of Twitch's "message deleted" placeholder. A second switch keeps the messages when a moderator clears the whole chat.

patches_added.name: Show video stats
patches_added.description: Adds the video stats button Twitch shows only to its staff to the native player: latency to the broadcaster, bitrate, buffer, dropped frames, codecs and server. Everything shown is local to the player.

patches_added.name: Sleep timer
patches_added.description: Pauses playback a chosen time after it last started or resumed, through Twitch's own pause for native, portal and React Native players, and says so in a short notice. Choose the time in Lurk settings; it is off until then.

patches_added.name: Tablet layout
patches_added.description: Adds a switch that makes Twitch treat the phone as a tablet: Home and the player rotate, the player shows chat beside the video in landscape, and a navigation rail on the left replaces the bottom bar in landscape (and in portrait too with a second switch). Off until turned on in Lurk settings; applies after a restart.

patches_added.name: Third-party badges
patches_added.description: Adds switches that show FrankerFaceZ and Chatterino badges and pronouns.alejo.io pronouns next to chatters' names in native chat. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings. The badge switches download that service's public list of all badge holders (api.frankerfacez.com, api.chatterino.com) about once an hour and check it on the phone. The pronouns switch sends the username of each chatter whose message you see to pronouns.alejo.io. 7TV badges are not included.

patches_added.name: Third-party emotes
patches_added.description: Adds switches that show 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes in chat, Twitch's chat history and VOD chat replay. Each switch is off until turned on in Lurk settings; when on, it sends the ID of the channel you watch to that service (7tv.io, api.betterttv.net, api.frankerfacez.com) for its emote lists and loads the emote images from its CDN. Not in the emote picker or autocomplete.

patches_added.name: VOD chapters

patches_added.name: Watch without signing in
